en: A colorized vintage postcard showing a fortified, elongated church or monastery complex with white walls and red roof tiles, built on a rocky hillside. A prominent bell tower with a clock stands near the center of the structure. Rugged green and brown rock formations rise behind the building. Faint printed Greek text appears at the upper left, and a website watermark "www.elia.org.gr" is visible at the bottom right.
